name: Thomas Riedel
note: Founder and owner of the Riedel Group / Riedel Communications Group, Wuppertal (fully privately owned by Thomas Riedel, per riedel-networks.net). Personal ownership, treated as a private owner, not a state. He is also majority owner of the Germany SailGP Team itself (team page and press, Feb 2026) - that concerns the club, not the sponsor.
